query: SELECT at.attribute_name, COUNT(*), MIN(ha.attribute_value), MAX(ha.attribute_value), AVG(ha.attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN attribute at ON ha.attribute_id=at.id GROUP BY 1

query: SELECT COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id), COUNT(DISTINCT attribute_id), MIN(attribute_value), MAX(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute

query: SELECT cnt, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) cnt FROM hero_attribute GROUP BY hero_id) GROUP BY cnt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute)
result: Every covered character has exactly 6 attributes: one group of 623 characters with cnt=6 and no other group. 127 characters have no attribute rows.
